verdicts.evidence: The logbook's five-dataset page states no fresh execution was performed: only an APAVA shell script was released, no checkpoints or cached metrics exist, and required datasets ADFTD, APAVA, PTB, PTB-XL, TDBRAIN were not run.
No datasets were executed (seeds 41-45 not run, only an APAVA script released), so the 20 top-1 / 3 top-2 result tally across five datasets could not be evaluated.

Concrete tests show the temporal-difference operator's first step equals the input (max_abs=72.0) instead of the declared zero, and the frequency filter has shape [12] broadcast across all 9 FFT bins, so it cannot perform frequency-specific band selection.

Two strongly different inputs produce identical adjacency (max |delta|=0.0), mutating graph parameters changes adjacency by 0.502 but changes the output by exactly 0.0, and classification-proxy gradients to nodevec1, nodevec2, and dynamic_gate parameters are all null.
No scaling or complexity experiments were run; the logbook does not measure runtime as a function of sequence length or compare against Transformer baselines on this axis.

overall: The logbook provides concrete code-level tests showing the released implementation does not implement the paper's described temporal-difference, frequency-selective, or adaptive-graph pathways as specified, with the adjacency matrix disconnected from the classifier output. However, no full five-dataset experiments were executed, so the empirical accuracy and ranking claims remain unverified.
